title: Holiday spirit at City-funded shelters
description:
“A sense of belonging, community and celebration.” City-funded shelters are celebrating the holidays in their own way.

To spread some cheer, Alpha Project @alphaprojectforthehomeless brings in large trees every year, and one site even has an ornament decorating competition! 🎄 

We’re grateful for our nonprofit partners who work to make this time of year special for people working to end their homelessness. 

#SanDiego
